description.narrative: On behalf of the VU-YPC Morocco partnership, we would like to introduce the VU-YPC PD Fellowship Visit. This PD visit will have the purpose to consolidate the previous project Youth Voice Matter (2022), where new local YPC branches were established in a knowledge exchange visit to Denmark visiting VU for seven days. Three YPC representatives will have the chance to incorporate the learnt practises into their local framework in Morocco. The nature of the activities during visit can be catagorised as national organisational exchange, local organisational exchange and finally partnership, culture and social activities. Which will be important for the future partnership project commencing at the same time as the Fellowship Visit. By transferring knowledge of democratic practises, and the intergenerational transfer of board practises in local YPC branches.
